> Record observed behavior only. Do not include medical information, credentials, private project data, confidential security details, or other sensitive personal information. Automated scores and screenshots alone do not count as a human test session.

## Test type

Select every area actually covered in this session.

- [ ] Human keyboard-only navigation
- [ ] Desktop screen reader
- [ ] Mobile screen reader
- [ ] Browser zoom at 200%
- [ ] Browser zoom at 300%
- [ ] Browser zoom at 400%
- [ ] Reflow at approximately 320 CSS pixels
- [ ] Text resize or increased text settings
- [ ] Light and dark themes
- [ ] Reduced motion
- [ ] Forced colors or high contrast
- [ ] Small phone
- [ ] Modern phone
- [ ] Tablet portrait and landscape
- [ ] Desktop or laptop
- [ ] Ultra-wide desktop

## Core workflow reviewed

Select only tasks that were performed in this environment.

- [ ] Page purpose, title, headings, and landmarks reviewed
- [ ] Skip link, navigation, theme control, and primary action reviewed
- [ ] Focus order and visible focus indicators reviewed
- [ ] Optional project-profile fields entered and edited
- [ ] Four assessment states reviewed: Complete, In progress, Not started, and Not applicable
- [ ] Evidence URL, item note, last-reviewed date, and responsible-person fields reviewed
- [ ] Improvement guidance, resource links, and limitation notices reviewed
- [ ] Guided Markdown starter editor and supported copy, download, and restore actions reviewed
- [ ] Core, maturity, and overall score changes reviewed
- [ ] Project notes and local persistence after reload reviewed
- [ ] Valid JSON export and import reviewed
- [ ] Invalid JSON error handling reviewed
- [ ] Native file-picker cancel and focus return reviewed where applicable
- [ ] Print preview or print explanation reviewed where applicable
- [ ] Reset confirmation and complete workspace clearing reviewed
- [ ] Documentation, roadmap, community, policy, and footer links reviewed
- [ ] No keyboard trap, focus loss, clipped content, overlap, or unreachable control found

## Assistive-technology observations

When a screen reader or other assistive technology was used, record whether:

- [ ] Repeated status controls included the assessment-item title
- [ ] Evidence fields and details included the assessment-item title
- [ ] Improvement-guidance sections were distinguishable by assessment item
- [ ] Starter editors and actions included the starter and assessment-item context
- [ ] Theme state, scores, progress changes, and tool-status messages were understandable
- [ ] Decorative visuals were ignored appropriately

## Result

Choose one:

- [ ] Pass
- [ ] Pass with observations
- [ ] Needs work
- [ ] Incomplete — does not satisfy a results-matrix requirement

## Observations

Describe what worked, anything confusing, and differences between orientations, zoom levels, themes, contrast settings, motion settings, or assistive-technology modes.

## Problems found

Create one focused issue for each defect with reproducible steps, expected behavior, actual behavior, impact, environment, and any safe evidence.

- Related issue(s):

## Evidence

Add public screenshots, recordings, or notes only when they do not expose private information. Link this session from `docs/manual-accessibility-results.md` after review.

## Confirmation

- [ ] I performed the selected tests personally in the environment recorded above.
- [ ] I did not substitute automated scores or simulated claims for human observations.
- [ ] I removed credentials, private project data, medical information, and other sensitive information.
- [ ] I agree to follow the OpenReady Code of Conduct.
